001: Lucas, did you see the discussion thread about the project?
Yes, I skimmed through it this morning. There are a lot of messages.
I feel like we're losing track. We should put everything together.
Good idea. I can create a summary document if you want.
That would be perfect. Thanks, Lucas.
No problem. I'll take care of it this afternoon.
002: I sent an email to the client, but I haven't gotten a response.
How long have you been waiting?
Two days. I'm starting to get worried.
Maybe he's away on a trip. You can politely follow up with him.
You're right. I'll send him a little reminder.
Yes, and you can offer him a video call.
003: I received a somewhat curt email from management.
Oh really? What is it about?
They want a detailed report before Friday.
That's a tight deadline. Do you already have the data?
Not all of it. I'm missing the figures from the last quarter.
I can send them to you. I have them in a spreadsheet.
004: Can you proofread my draft before I send it?
Of course, send it to me. I'll take a look at it today.
Thanks. I mainly want to check the tone.
Okay. Do you want me to watch out for mistakes too?
Yes, if you can. I'm always a bit unsure about grammar agreements.
No problem. I'll give you quick feedback.
005: I get the feeling that some colleagues don't read my emails.
Maybe it's because they're too long.
You think? I go into a lot of detail to be clear.
I understand, but the main point sometimes gets lost.
You're right. I'll try to get straight to the point.
And you can put the important points in bold.
006: I was copied on a very tense exchange.
Oh really? Between who and who?
Between two department heads. It's escalating.
Maybe you should suggest a meeting to calm things down.
That's a good idea. I'll suggest it by email.
Yes, and stay neutral in your message.
007: I need to send an email to cancel a meeting.
Do you have a good excuse?
I have a last-minute conflict, that's true.
Then, suggest another date in your message.
Yes, I'll suggest two time slots for next week.
That's a good approach. It shows your good faith.
008: I got a very positive response to my proposal.
Great! What exactly do they say?
They're interested, but they want more details.
Are you going to send them a supplementary document?
Yes, I'm going to prepare a note with concrete examples.
Perfect. And you can offer them a call to discuss it.
009: Are you still using the signature with the logo?
Yes, why? Is there a problem?
I was told we have to use the new template.
Oh, I wasn't aware. Can you send it to me?
Of course. I'll forward you the message from comms.
Thanks, I'll update it right away.
010: I have a hard time keeping up with all the emails when I'm in a meeting.
Me too. I only check my inbox three times a day.
That's a good method. I should do the same.
Yes, and you can use filters to sort them automatically.
Good idea. I'll create folders by project.
That's going to save you a lot of precious time.
